Devon (Vendor Ops): Heads-up: Vendor CloudGrid invoiced us twice for GPU rental hours on 2027-02-03 (INV-CG-778). They sent two invoices for overlapping time windows.
Maya (Finance): Can you paste the vendor invoice IDs and amounts? we may need a manual vendor reimbursement/adjustment.
Devon (Vendor Ops): Invoice summary:
- INV-CG-778-A: GPU rental 2027-02-03 00:00-08:00 UTC: $18,600
- INV-CG-778-B: GPU rental (duplicate) 2027-02-03 00:00-08:00 UTC: $18,600
Total charged: $37,200
Maya (Finance): Yikes. Did CloudGrid confirm it was a duplicate on their side?
Devon (Vendor Ops): They acknowledged a billing-system replay and requested Redwood issue a vendor credit request so they can net it on their statement. They attached vendor support ticket #CG-SUP-442.
Oskar (Accounting): For vendor-side duplicates, policy is to request vendor credit and then, if vendor won't reissue, Redwood can apply a one-off manual adjustment to vendor cost center for reconciliation. Approval needed for >$10k. Tagging @Maya.
Maya (Finance): I approve issuing a one-time reversal on our P&L to correct the duplicate vendor charge and to create a payable-credit against CloudGrid. Reason: vendor replay duplicated invoice window. Memo must reference CG-SUP-442.
Devon (Vendor Ops): Creating vendor-credit record: `vendor-cli credit create --vendor CloudGrid --invoice INV-CG-778-B --amount 18600 --currency USD --reason "duplicate invoice replay" --ticket CG-SUP-442 --approver maya_finance`
billing-bot: Vendor credit request submitted: VCR-2027-00421 pending approval. Link: https://vendorpay.internal/credits/VCR-2027-00421
Oskar (Accounting): I'll allocate the reversal to cost center INFRA-GPUs after approval and reconcile in AP. Once CloudGrid issues their credit note, we'll net it off payable.
Maya (Finance): Approved in system. Please ensure documentation: attach CloudGrid email and their ticket.
billing-bot: VCR-2027-00421 APPROVED by maya_finance at 2027-02-03T12:15:05Z. Reversal posted: $18,600. Pending vendor-side confirmation.
Devon (Vendor Ops): Notified CloudGrid to confirm their outbound credit note. They responded: "Confirming we'll issue CG-CN-778 on 2027-02-04 and apply against future statement."
Oskar (Accounting): Marking entry as pending vendor CN CG-CN-778. Will run a reconciliation sweep next week to confirm netting.
Maya (Finance): Adding this to monthly vendor adjustments and flagging CloudGrid as high-touch until their billing replay root-cause is fixed.
Devon (Vendor Ops): Filing follow-up with vendor to add idempotency to their invoice webhook. Ticket CG-ENG-88 created.
Maya (Finance): Thanks team. Please paste vendor credit note here when received so we can close the loop.
Devon (Vendor Ops): Will do. Closing thread for now.
